name: run_finops_query
description: Run one grouped aggregation over the FinOps cost dice for a billing period. Returns aggregated rows and the display SQL. Never returns raw usage lines.

group_by.description: Dimension: service, account, region, usage_kind, instance_type, or commitment_scope.

comparison_period.description: Optional earlier billing period. When set, each row includes earlier, later, and change.

top_n.description: Maximum rows to return, from 1 to 12.
